{{Quote|Did you hear? Sesree is missing. Her husband hasn't seen her for weeks.''"<br />"''Really strange. Never thought she'd just up and leave, especially with her Pa the way he is.|Two Kessan's Landing residents|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
'''Sesree''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who resided with her husband on [[Kessan's Landing]], on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], during the [[Third Galactic War]]. She disappeared<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> likely captured by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the  [[Hidden Chain]] during their [[raid on Kessan's Landing]].<ref name="TOR"/>
